title: Initial Risk Probing and Feasibility Testing of Glow: a Generative AI-Powered Dialectical Behavior Therapy Skills Coach for Substance Use Recovery and HIV Prevention
reasoning: The study evaluates AI safety performance using the Helpful, Honest, and Harmless (HHH) framework and explicitly includes 'Moral or Religious Justification Risk' as one of its seven thematic risk categories. It specifically tests how the model handles user inputs that use religious faith (e.g., 'natural plants are gifts from God') to justify substance use.
